llm_response.reason: The website presents several scam characteristics: impersonation of a well-known brand (Peuterey) with no visible proof of authorization; absence of clear company background, legitimate 'About Us', or verifiable business contact information; use of psychological assurances and urgency tactics with offers and free shipping; generic contact links rather than professional business contacts; ambiguous or missing customer privacy notation; and overall site structure mimicking legitimate e-commerce platforms commonly seen in scam/fake shopping portals.
